actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The behir makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .4fNbTxkAFYHxDdJX]]{bite} and one to [[/item .GCUh42hMUnKtxx8j]]{constrict}.

actions.name: constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. [[/damage extended]]. The target is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 16) if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is &reference[restrained] until this grapple ends.

actions.name: lightning breath
actions.desc: The behir exhales a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=iG0MT0sZv95VBmZK]] of lightning. Each creature in that line must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .4fNbTxkAFYHxDdJX]]{Bite} attack against a Medium or smaller target it is &reference[grappling]. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=JiBTCgEtAZs60k7R]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. A [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=2pCVkETAYg7qALRu]] saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].
